answer: The summit test I would run is Massage therapist licence with health board attestation: a licence number in the health board register, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. What makes this stick is that a licence number in the health board register cannot be faked in bulk — each proof is independent, and the meadow of independence is that one compromised proof endangers no other account. This is the asymmetry that matters — verification is cheap, forgery is expensive, and the gale of forging a hundred proofs is a hundred times the cost of forging one.
